decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side  walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for kitchen purpose shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 5 - Informative.

The permission hereby granted refers only to the building operation involved. It must not be taken as representing acceptance of any new use. In particular it does not include the internal uses shown on the approved drawings, nor does it invalidate or replace the recent decision to refuse planning permission for the sale of hot food from the premises (00550/204/P10).
description: Demolition of the existing rear garage & the erection of a single storey rear extension to the shop premises.
